turns.doctor_question: Hello, and welcome. I'm Dr. [Name], a psychiatrist. What brings you in to see me today?
turns.patient_response:
Hello, doctor. Well, what brought me in is that I've been having some trouble with how much I'm eating at night. 

After my evening class, I sometimes stop for food on the way back. I'll end up eating a full fast-food meal... then I'll grab candy from the vending machine, and when I finally get home, I just keep going with more snacks. It's almost like I'm making up for the whole day in one sitting. I just thought I should probably talk to someone about it.

symptom_reasoning.S049: The patient describes consuming an unusually large amount of food in a single evening/sitting, including a full fast-food meal, candy, and subsequent snacks at home.

turns.doctor_question: After these eating episodes at night, do you do anything to try to compensate or make up for what you've eaten, such as making yourself vomit, exercising excessively, or restricting food the next day?
turns.patient_response: Well, yes. A few times after those late-night eating spells, I've gone into the bathroom and made myself throw up. I just... I was really scared that all that food would start to show on me. I haven't really done the exercise thing you mentioned, but I have made myself sick a couple of times.

symptom_reasoning.S048: The patient explicitly confirms making themselves throw up after late-night eating episodes due to fear of the food showing on them.
symptom_reasoning.S047: The patient explicitly denies engaging in excessive exercise as a compensatory behavior.

turns.doctor_question: How often would you say you've made yourself throw up after these eating episodes—is it happening most of the time after a binge, or just occasionally?
turns.patient_response: Well, looking back on it, I'd say this has been going on for about the past three months. Usually, there's at least one night each week after my class where I end up overeating like that... and then I make myself throw up afterward. So, I guess it's about once a week.

symptom_reasoning.S048: The patient explicitly confirms engaging in self-induced vomiting ('make myself throw up afterward') approximately once a week for the past three months.
